source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: After this model has finished shooting in your **Shooting phase**, each enemy unit that took at least one hit from its **Indirect Fire** weapons makes a **Battle-shock test**. Whenever one of those **Indirect Fire** attacks destroys an enemy model with **Deadly Demise**, that model’s **Deadly Demise** deals mortal wounds when its D6 shows 5+, not just on a 6.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

clauses.target: every enemy unit struck by at least one of those Indirect Fire attacks

clauses.trigger: one of those Indirect Fire attacks destroys an enemy model with Deadly Demise
